name: ESP32-S3 board over local wireless
description: A dedicated board joins the Civ VII wireless lobby and streams the save over LDN UDP :9027. No PC, no network, no keys on the console.

requirements.keys: prod.keys at build time only (baked into keys.h, never committed)

networkImpact.releases: nothing on the host; the board uses its own radio

notes: The only entry exercised on hardware so far.
Fully offline: the board never leaves the local-wireless link.
